scripts.dev: node build.mjs && source venv/bin/activate && python server.py
scripts.db:migrate: source venv/bin/activate && flask --app server db migrate
scripts.db:upgrade: source venv/bin/activate && flask --app server db upgrade
scripts.db:downgrade: source venv/bin/activate && flask --app server db downgrade
scripts.db:history: source venv/bin/activate && flask --app server db history
